create_dashboard.name: Create dashboard
create_dashboard.description: Creates a managed Battman dashboard in the sidebar. Does nothing if one already exists; dashboards you have taken control of are never touched.

dashboard_unavailable.title: Battman could not create its dashboard
dashboard_unavailable.description:
Home Assistant's dashboard internals have changed, so Battman could not create its dashboard ({error}). Create it by hand: Settings → Dashboards → Add dashboard → New dashboard from scratch, then ⋮ → Raw configuration editor and replace everything with:

```yaml
strategy:
  type: custom:battman
```
